svg.text: One axle module; wheel blanks retained. Near wheel and coupling guard removed in these views.
Four SKF 32018 X bearings per axle; journals Ø90
Roll cradles: Ø60 pins in GE60 ES-2RS bearings
Motor-side cartridge fixed axially; other end ±8 float
Motor carrier: backplate + two webs + flange plate
GEARex FA25: Ø213 ×157; custom hubs held
Drive hub Ø80 bore; custom motor spline hub
Motor shaft tip Y843; flange Y945; rear Y1151
Reaction path: flange → carrier → trunnions → guides
Housing and carrier tilt with the axle; coupling stays aligned
DT5 R1 · 20 October 2026 · mm · Development geometry; supplier and structural approval required before fabrication.
